findings.detail: The architecture cleanly decouples three environments: (1) PromptGemini (.github/workflows/prompt-gemini-context-rich-dialogue.yml + gemini-message-executor.js) hosts the five-pass AI-NLE evaluation dialogue; (2) MetaProcedure JS Runner (js-runner.js) is a Node.js CLI runner that parses JSON and executes JavaScript found in 'script' fields; (3) Google Apps Script (Code.gs doPost bridge) executes remote Google Workspace APIs (DriveApp, Utilities) via HTTP POST.

Pass 1 noted the 25MB cap was invented, but overlooked why: Google Apps Script has hard execution runtime (6 min) and blob memory limits (~50MB). However, rather than an arbitrary 25MB hardcoded cap, the procedure must inspect ZIP metadata safely, handle unzipping errors gracefully in Apps Script without silent failure, and record inspection status deterministically.

Under 731942_ai_nlep_meta_procedure.json, an NLEP must include 16+ canonical objects (definitions, instructions with operation ledgers, constraints, invariants, state_model, transition_model, verification_model, error_model, procedure_execution_semantics, self_evaluation). Current procedure.json is an ad-hoc stub with a raw script string.

Current procedure.json considers the procedure complete when Drive file ID and URL are parsed from HTTP response. Per MetaProcedure VP3/VP4/VC8/VC9, action occurrence (Node.js script execution) and external effect (Google Drive report creation) must be distinctly tracked and verified.
